items.body:
## R2 OWNER-AUTHORIZED RECOVERY-STANDARD REVISION PROPOSED — 2026-11-12 (NOT ADOPTED)

**New reviewer self-attestations received but not verifiable — 2026-11-12 10:46 UTC:** [DBA declaration #6821470186](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/pull/698#issuecomment-6821470186) and [privacy declaration #6821489308](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/issues/700#issuecomment-6821489308) from `thedetourclubind-cloud` each claim five years of experience and personal authorship. **Both still contain placeholder brackets for the type of relevant experience, actual professional credential/evidence reference, appointing organization and appointment date**. A self-attestation under a GitHub handle with unfilled authority/qualification evidence **does not verify** qualified independent DBA or privacy/security decision-making; the same handle claims both roles and has not supplied an independently assessed conflict/independence basis. Conditional design-review opinions remain for owner consideration **only**, not valid sign-offs or adoption. Do not merge pending [R2 PRs #667/#685/#686/#697/#698](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/issues/518) or [AI PRs #671/#676/#678/#679](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/pull/671) as an unreviewed bundle. PR #698 current head `a974e6e07e0507e225c2ab1d552aa74e6c69783e` remains Draft/unmerged, CI/CodeQL green. Recovery execution, hosted/local SQL, historical ledger repair, exports/restore, merges, deployments, collector activation, staging-hold lift **NOT AUTHORIZED**. Retain dual **no-egress** and **no-unintended-mutation** gates. **0/16 ON HOLD; R2 NO-GO**. Existing production remains separate from these blocked changes.



**Conditional design acceptance recorded but reviewer authority NOT VERIFIED — 2026-11-12 10:37 UTC:** Two new decisions on exact PR #698 head `a974e6e07e0507e225c2ab1d552aa74e6c69783e`: [DBA/recovery comment #6821290780](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/pull/698#issuecomment-6821290780) says **ACCEPT PROPOSED REVISED STAGING STANDARD — DESIGN ACCEPTANCE ONLY**; [privacy/security comment #6821299330](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/issues/700#issuecomment-6821299330) says **ACCEPT WITH CONDITIONS — DESIGN ACCEPTANCE ONLY**. **Both still contain unfilled `[Complete personally ...]` qualifications, delegated decision authority, independence/conflict and date fields.** Therefore they are *conditional design opinions*, **NOT verified qualified independent reviewer sign-offs**, owner adoption or any rehearsal GO. A qualified reviewer must personally complete and substantiate credentials/authority and independence; if those cannot be verified the owner must nominate replacements. Both decisions require synthetic-only tenant A/B fixtures, pre-start and continuous no-egress, no-unintended-mutation controls (disable/exclude cron/pg_net/Vault, retry jobs, payment/lead triggers, learning jobs and other unreviewed side effects), object allowlist/exclusion manifest, named operator/witness/incident/cleanup roles, pinned tools/hashes and approved evidence retention/deletion. Physical Nov 10 backup, physical RPO/RTO and complete Supabase Auth/Storage/Vault recovery remain **UNVERIFIED**. **PR #698 DRAFT/UNMERGED**, original proposal **NOT ADOPTED**; no exports, SQL/restore, ledger repair, PR #685 rerun, merge, deploy, collector activation or staging release. **0/16 ON HOLD; R2 NO-GO.** No duplicate reviewer pings needed.



**Additional source-level side-effect risks and reviewer-identity follow-up — 2026-11-12:** [PR #698 source triage #6820724277](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/pull/698#issuecomment-6820724277) identifies additional **repository-only**, not staging-confirmed, scheduled SQL paths for Instagram DM retries, Instagram outbound echo retries, closed-won lead auto-archive, outcome learning, and the already-known Vault/pg_net automation scheduler, plus a payment INSERT/UPDATE trigger capable of changing lead state. **Network no-egress alone does not prohibit data mutation.** For any option A fabricated, narrow-scope rehearsal, proposed disposition is to exclude cron registrations/execution and unsafe triggers by default, with exact dependency/side-effect allowlist and signed fidelity limitations; options and exclusions still need qualified DBA and privacy decisions. Source keyword search is partial and **does not prove installed stage state or a complete catalog**. [DBA reviewer completion request #6820694999](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/pull/698#issuecomment-6820694999) explicitly asks `thedetourclubind-cloud` to complete role, qualifications, authority, independence and personally authored operational decision; [privacy candidate completion request #6820697864](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/issues/700#issuecomment-6820697864) requires qualified privacy reviewer to complete the still-placeholder decision. **Neither gate is approved.** PR #698 docs review/CI acceptance only; draft/unmerged. No SQL/export/restore/ledger repair/merge/deploy/collector activation/hold lift. **Staging 0/16 ON HOLD; R2 NO-GO.** No redundant reviewer ping needed.



**New review outcomes — 2026-11-12 10:01 UTC (non-executable):** [PR #698 reviewer comment #6820550996](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/pull/698#issuecomment-6820550996) records a substantive **CHANGES REQUIRED** decision at the exact docs head `a974e6e07e0507e225c2ab1d552aa74e6c69783e`, but both **professional qualifications and decision-making authority still say `[Reviewer to complete personally]`**. It does **NOT** constitute verified qualified DBA acceptance or permission for a rehearsal. Outstanding conditions: independently reconciled exact schema/object manifest, pre-start and continuing witnessed no-egress controls, explicit pg_net/Vault/cron/indirect-outbound dispositions, synthetic tenant A/B only, named operator/witness/incident/cleanup owners, pinned versions/hashes, fail/rollback/evidence/retention/deletion controls, and explicit physical-backup/managed-platform omissions. Separate [AI-assisted DBA technical advisory #6820509994](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/pull/698#issuecomment-6820509994) is **advisory only**, not human sign-off. [Issue #700 AI-assisted privacy advisory #6820527690](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/issues/700#issuecomment-6820527690) likewise recommends CHANGES REQUIRED but explicitly **cannot certify qualifications, authority, independence or privacy approval**. **Formal independent privacy decision still PENDING**. Prior doc-only code review/CI acceptance is unaffected; owner adoption and named-operator execution are NOT authorized. No dump, SQL, restore, ledger repair, merge, deploy or staging hold change. **R2 NO-GO; 0/16 ON HOLD.** Do not create another generic reviewer request in response to these findings.



**Documentation-only acceptance clarified — 2026-11-12 09:50:53 UTC:** After the empty-body [current-head GitHub APPROVED review #5872293311](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/pull/698#pullrequestreview-5872293311), reviewer `thedetourclubind-cloud` posted a [written scope clarification #6820336537](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/pull/698#issuecomment-6820336537): **PR #698 recovery DOCUMENTATION ACCEPTED only** at exact head `a974e6e07e0507e225c2ab1d552aa74e6c69783e`; full CI and CodeQL passed. That clarification expressly says this is **NOT** operational DBA acceptance, privacy/security approval, owner adoption, migration-history reconciliation permission, authority to rerun PR #685 SQL, export/restore/execute SQL, merge/deploy, or release the staging hold. At that checkpoint, no subsequent written `ACCEPT FOR CONTROLLED REHEARSAL / CHANGES REQUIRED / REJECT` operational decision had superseded [the substantive DBA CHANGES REQUIRED finding #6818757836](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/pull/698#issuecomment-6818757836). Privacy/security Issue #700 has no qualified, substantive independent decision. **0/16 ON HOLD, R2 NO-GO**. No further duplicate reviewer request or new speculative PR should be generated just to reassert this status.



**New current-head GitHub APPROVED is NOT DBA operational acceptance — 2026-11-12 09:46:23 UTC:** [Review #5872293311](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/pull/698#pullrequestreview-5872293311) by `thedetourclubind-cloud` is marked APPROVED but has an **empty body**; it follows the [substantive re-review request #6820127126](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/pull/698#issuecomment-6820127126). It does **not** explicitly choose ACCEPT FOR CONTROLLED REHEARSAL / CHANGES REQUIRED / REJECT, address replacement-vs-supplementary scope, egress/Vault/cron controls, manifest completeness, or unverified physical RPO/RTO. Accordingly the previous substantive **DBA CHANGES REQUIRED** finding remains unclosed; do not count GitHub code approval as an independent operational recovery decision. No privacy qualifications or separate reasoned decision in #700; owner adoption, actual recovery GO, staging hold lift, migrations and production release remain **NOT AUTHORIZED**. PR #698 is still Draft/unmerged, current-head CI + CodeQL passed, 0/16 staging ON HOLD, R2 NO-GO. No duplicate review request is necessary.



**Latest-head engineering verification — 2026-11-12:** At the exact [PR #698 docs-only head `a974e6e0`](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/commit/a974e6e07e0507e225c2ab1d552aa74e6c69783e), GitHub [CI run #43189932033](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/actions/runs/43189932033) and [CodeQL run #43189931997](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/actions/runs/43189931997) both **COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY**. This closes automated-check verification **only**. **Independent DBA substantive decision remains CHANGES REQUIRED**, nominated privacy reviewer has not provided qualifications or a separate decision in #700, and owner adoption/operator execution GO do not exist. This recovery proposal is **not adopted**; no source export, local/hosted SQL, migration/ledger repair, merge, deployment or staging hold lift is authorized. **0/16 ON HOLD; R2 NO-GO.**



**New outbound-capability source finding — 2026-11-12:** [PR #698 commit `a974e6e0`](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/commit/a974e6e07e0507e225c2ab1d552aa74e6c69783e) adds section **6.2d** to the recovery packet. The repository recovery migration `supabase/recovery/20261017091453_automation_runtime_scheduler_foundation_v1.sql` (blob `f97f24b9252e242268d29adb74a54fb500f5357d`) defines `pg_net`/`pg_cron`/`supabase_vault` integration and a default-disabled scheduler function that can call `net.http_get` using a Vault secret when enabled. **This is source-only evidence of a potential egress path; not evidence it is active in staging** (prior dated installed-extension screen matched only `pg_cron`). The four stage-only SQL files' negative keyword scan is **not** a comprehensive safety claim. DBA must independently classify and exclude/neutralize this path before any import, plus require network isolation before SQL execution. **No export, local/hosted SQL, restore, merge, deployment or GO.** R2 NO-GO; staging 0/16 ON HOLD.



**Static source-risk triage added (review-only, 2026-11-12):** [PR #698 commit `df1e5e89`](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/commit/df1e5e89aa1cb3e9ef7718db7539e3cbdc3869b2) adds section **6.2c**. The pinned #685 and three #686 SQL source files have no *direct* outbound-network primitive matches in a limited keyword scan; **this is NOT proof of no egress, trigger safety or current-hosted recovery**. The uninstalled #686 lead-ingestion source invokes `attach_visitor_journey_to_lead` and `refresh_lead_attribution_internal`; their indirect dependencies remain unverified. **Conservative recommendation for DBA review:** current PR #697/#685 repository-only synthetic rehearsal is **SUPPLEMENTARY ONLY**, not a recovery test for all 214 public staging tables / 389 public functions. Current-hosted schema reconstructability likely requires separately approved option B (schema-only scoped export and verified offline isolation), or a transparently narrowed owner-signed staging standard. This is **a recommendation, not DBA acceptance or export authorization**. New-head CI/CodeQL **PENDING** at authoring. Privacy reviewer #700, DBA acceptance, final owner adoption and operator GO still outstanding; staging **0/16 ON HOLD**, R2 **NO-GO**.



**Exact-source ACL signature appendix added — 2026-11-12:** [PR #698 draft commit 67ccc77e](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/commit/67ccc77e328aeae07235cdf9a4fcb849e2d1242c) adds section **6.2b** with **all 26 REVOKE EXECUTE and 4 ALTER FUNCTION search_path statements**, including exact function signatures, derived directly from reviewed #685 Git blob `4dce41ad8f75d486c33e1364646ca24d44bf5c31`. This closes *a source-indexed subset*, not the full hosted object manifest, current-catalog parity, no-egress proof, or DBA approval. PR is docs-only Draft/unmerged; **latest-head CI/CodeQL have not yet been confirmed**. The DBA still must decide repository-only option A vs separately authorized schema-export option B and accept/require changes/reject; privacy #700, owner adoption and operator GO remain pending. **No SQL executed; staging 0/16 ON HOLD; R2 NO-GO.**



**Source-indexed manifest added — 2026-11-12:** [PR #698 docs-only head ef93995d](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/commit/ef93995dc4e5cc3c40c4801460b96c96c1330290) adds section **6.2a**, an exact Git-blob referenced *partial* object/dependency classification for PR #685 (26 function EXECUTE revocations + 4 search_path alterations) and the three PR #686 **uninstalled** stage-only candidates (automation function/seven tables, two proposed privacy tables, lead-ingestion RPC). The manifest explicitly separates **Git candidate** from **hosted observed** and identifies a DBA decision between repository-only synthetic option A versus separately authorized hosted schema-export option B. This is **NOT** a 214-table/389-function full hosted catalog or reconstruction evidence; do not close the object-manifest gate. New-head CI/CodeQL must be evaluated for the latest SHA. DBA review remains CHANGES REQUIRED, privacy pending, owner adoption/execution not authorized; 0/16 ON HOLD, R2 NO-GO.



**DBA condition-closure DESIGN PACKAGE SUBMITTED — 2026-11-12:** [PR #698 draft documentation head 83e2a320](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/commit/83e2a320bf26998e18ecc80d83d250df5f66ca7e) adds [sections 6.1–6.7 of the recovery packet](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/blob/docs/r2-physical-backup-restore-preflight-20261112/docs/checkpoints/R2-Logical-Recovery-DBA-Decision-Packet-20261112.md): bounded replacement-vs-supplemental scope, dated aggregate catalog and open object-level manifest, pre-start no-egress/witness test design, synthetic tenant A/B acceptance matrix, version/source and migration provenance, stop/rollback, evidence IDs and roles. **DBA conditions remain OPEN:** no environment built or proven, complete object manifest/operator/independent witness not assigned, toolchain and actual export hash not pinned, no signed DBA acceptance. This is a new reviewable design deliverable, **NOT** a completed recovery test or permission to execute. Separate privacy #700 and owner adoption remain pending. R2 NO-GO; staging 0/16 ON HOLD.



**Updated independent DBA review — 2026-11-12:** [DBA comment #6818757836](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/pull/698#issuecomment-6818757836) has now been **edited to explicitly state `CHANGES REQUIRED — REVIEW RECORD INCOMPLETE`** and enumerates control/evidence prerequisites. This is a substantive **changes-required finding**, **not ACCEPTANCE** of the revised recovery standard. A [separate current-head GitHub APPROVED review #5871412825](https://github.com/yogakulamacademy/salsys-os/pull/698#pullrequestreview-5871412825) has an **empty body** and does not supersede that decision. **Next deliverable: reviewable condition-closure design package** — limited staging replacement-vs-supplemental scope, schema/role/RLS/function/trigger/extension manifest, pre-execution no-egress design and independently witnessed negative test procedure, synthetic tenant A/B fixtures, explicitly excluded data/Auth/Storage/Vault/secrets, pinned tool/hash runbook, failure/rollback/cleanup controls, named operator/witness/incident roles, and evidence collection plan. *Design sign-off precedes separately authorized execution; observed rehearsal results cannot be required before the execution GO.* Hosted ledger `20261110041634` reconciliation and PR #685 SQL must remain separate; no history repair authorized. items.title: Add auditor-led budget extensions without cancelling healthy missions

labels.name: ui-ux
labels.description: Actual ECorp console user experience workstream

items.body:
## Outcome

Allow healthy ECorp work to continue through independently audited, bounded budget extensions instead of cancelling a task or mission at its normal working allowance. Reuse the existing budget ledger, circuit-breaker incidents, task contracts, authorization, and durable control infrastructure; do not introduce a second scheduler or spending ledger.

## Approved policy target

- Initial working allowance: 1,000,000 tokens, replacing the 200,000-token sizing used for #235.
- Trigger an independent budget audit at 70% of the current working allowance, or earlier when forecast next-call usage would exhaust safe headroom.
- Permit justified extensions of at most 250,000 tokens per decision, within a 2,000,000-token total authorized mission envelope. Account for all participating workers, retries, and auditor usage within the applicable mission/requester/Corp limits.
- Retain the existing $10 cost setting. The current Codex adapter reports cost as zero, so zero telemetry is not proof of zero billing or enforceable cost headroom. Explicitly distinguish measured, estimated, cached, and unpriced usage when available.
- Extensions beyond the authorized envelope require a new human authorization. No unlimited self-escalation, usage reset, verifier bypass, publication, merge, or deployment authority is granted.

These values are an approved implementation target, not evidence that the stopped #235 task or any live deployment already has this policy.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Add a scoped, versioned owner/admin delegation policy for an independent auditor identity. The producing agent cannot approve its own increase, act as the auditor, grant itself owner/admin status, or obtain broad control-plane or publication credentials.
- [ ] Trigger and deduplicate early audits at 70%/forecast exhaustion, reserving bounded audit headroom. Auditor activity must not create an unbounded chain of audits or escape aggregate accounting.
- [ ] Persist an evidence-backed decision with original/current/proposed/remaining allowance, per-call input/output usage and available cache/cost breakdown, actual progress/diffs/tests, repeated failures, remaining-work estimate, rationale, actor identity, timestamps, and evidence references.
- [ ] If continued work is justified, atomically update the applicable task, run, and mission allowance within the delegated envelope. Revalidate source, tenant/Corp/room, actor role, contract version, current usage, and all enclosing budget scopes immediately before the grant. Duplicate or concurrent decisions must not double-grant headroom.
- [ ] Keep healthy work in the same task/mission and provider/workspace lineage during a successful soft-threshold extension. Preserve original limits, cumulative spend, immutable audit history, and monotonic breaker transitions; never silently clear incidents or reset counters.
- [ ] Missing tools, repeated equivalent failures, absent progress, unknown cost assurance, or unsafe continuation produce a reasoned flag and a deduplicated linked issue when appropriate, not blind budget increases. Resume only after the blocking condition is repaired and the continuation remains authorized.
- [ ] If the auditor is unavailable, denies the increase, or the outer envelope is exhausted, enter a recoverable waiting state rather than representing ordinary budget review as permanent mission cancellation. Keep genuine security, emergency-stop, hard-stop, quarantine, and aggregate-spending denials effective.
- [ ] Expose the allowance, audit status, decisions, reasons, and remaining headroom in the existing operating UI. Do not create duplicate human approval prompts for extensions already covered by a current scoped delegation.
- [ ] Add deterministic coverage for near-limit calls, two concurrent workers/auditors, duplicate/lost responses, revocation, changed source/contract, auditor failure, missing runtime tools, task-versus-mission caps, another overrun, and resume continuity. Exercise the full browser/server/runner path in explicitly owned disposable fixtures and run the AGENTS.md gate.
- [ ] Obtain independent outcome review. Keep deterministic fixture evidence distinct from any separately authorized real-provider acceptance run; no merge or deployment is authorized by this item.

## Dependencies

Blocked by #50.

Coordinate with #56 (aggregate hard-budget enforcement), #87 (post-directive Codex usage), #144 (approval fatigue), and #164 (visible task allocations). Do not duplicate their existing work or weaken their safety boundaries.

## Current implementation evidence

At source 971445e1cbf9388c51803e2adf28b11bd98b1ffa:

- Mission budget revisions require owner/admin authority and no active run (crates/crony-store/src/budget_revision.rs).
- A finish-scope revision may reduce but cannot increase the task budget.
- Resume-contract revisions reject budget changes (crates/crony-store/src/contract_revision.rs).
- The current APIs therefore do not provide live, delegated auditor extensions or a coordinated task/run/mission allowance increase. Their presence must not be represented as support for this feature.

## Motivating incident: #235

The local #235 Codex run reported 208,704 input plus 960 output tokens (209,664 total) against a 200,000-token limit. Five model calls repeatedly encountered a missing codex-code-mode-host.exe beside the configured Codex executable. No scenario files, tests, or commits were produced. The budget breaker stopped the provider and preserved the worktree; checkpoint capture timed out and still requires verification before recovery.

An evidence-based auditor should flag the missing execution-tool host and withhold further failed retries until it is repaired. Merely increasing the budget would not repair that condition. The existing #235 mission, task, run, provider session, worktree, and consumed usage must remain preserved; this issue does not authorize replacing them.

## Governed delivery contract

- Repository: All-The-Vibes/ecorp. New-work planning authority: All-The-Vibes Project #5.
- Owner: Bakar404. Initial state: Todo, without factory:ready.
- This is a separate runtime/governance work item, not an expansion of #235's scenario-only write scope.
- Before implementation/dispatch, curate the exact source base, narrow write allocation, provider, implementation budget, and persisted verifier in its own branch/worktree and actual selected-issue dry run. Coordinate shared budget/schema/UI files with #50 and other active work.
- No writes in the configured source checkout, no retained-database fixtures, no credential changes, no unattended watcher, and no automatic publication/merge/deployment.

## Intent
Implement **PostgreSQL-first durable CEPIO MemoryStore and RetrievalBackend** after retiring Azure AI Search (ADR-0039). Preserve "thin infrastructure, thick Industry IQ": industry knowledge, evidence and governance live above replaceable persistence.

## Current boundary
- CEPIO mainline still operates on in-memory/SQLite reference repositories.
- PostgreSQL-backed cost-ledger infrastructure elsewhere in CEPIO Labs is a separate, proven workload; **it does not imply the main CEPIO runtime has migrated**.
- Reuse an existing appropriately isolated PostgreSQL service and managed identity only if tenancy, network access, policy and cost controls qualify; no new provisioning without expenditure approval.

## Delivery acceptance
- [ ] PostgreSQL-backed `MemoryStore` implementation behind existing semantic/procedural/episodic/profile memory contracts.
- [ ] Relational capability, decision and evidence metadata with structured and native full-text retrieval exposed as `RetrievalBackend`.
- [ ] Exact tenant, GLOBAL/PROFILE, expiry, provenance and bounded context behavior, with adversarial cross-tenant regression.
- [ ] Entra/managed identity, TLS, private network/residency, least privilege and no public credentials.
- [ ] Explicit schema migrations, idempotent replay, rollback, retention and backup/restore drill.
- [ ] Frozen competence/retrieval evals comparing PostgreSQL to existing SQLite/lexical baseline at representative 5K/50K synthetic corpus.
- [ ] SQL search ranking cannot grant evidence, policy, authority or maturity independently.
- [ ] Only consider `pgvector` after evidence-driven vector/hybrid ranking acceptance criteria; never mandatory for first cutover.
- [ ] Stage and qualify production cutover; leave `CEPIO_DB_URL` unchanged until end-to-end checks pass.
- [ ] Update docs, ADR, support/ops guidance, management observability and release-qualification evidence.

## Non-goals
No Azure AI Search resurrection; no new cloud capacity/spend without approval; no customer data copied into public CEPIO; no automatic deployment/cutover; no changes to generic Foundry execution ownership.

ADR-0039 in retirement PR #282.
